title: File:The wintry landscape of New Jersey, New York, and Connecticut (iss074e0209281).jpg
author: NASA Johnson Space Center
description: iss074e0209281 (Jan. 28, 2026) --- The wintry landscape of New Jersey, New York, and Connecticut is seen from the International Space Station as it orbited 259 miles above the Atlantic coast of the United States. Temperatures in New York City ranged from a low of about 14 degrees Fahrenheit to a high of around 23 degrees when this photograph was taken.
